This product contains 100% d-Alpha Vitamin E from natural food sources combined with d-Beta, d-Gamma, and d-Delta tocopherols, the rest of the vitamin E family.
Suggested use
Take one (1) softgel daily, preferably with a meal. 
Other ingredients
Gelatin, glycerin, purified water, soybean oil.

Does not contain: Gluten, sugar, salt, preservatives, artificial colors or flavors.
Warnings
Consult your healthcare provider prior to use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medication or have any medical conditions. 
Store in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children. Tamper evident. Do not use if outer seal is broken or missing.
